rules: Vorta use a humanoid morphology with species-specific facial/ear/eye presentation resolved from validated references.
Pale to cool/lilac skin and distinctive eye presentation may be used where the chosen screen-reference profile supports them.
Individual facial identity must remain broad enough to avoid cloning a small set of canonical Vorta.
Dominion administrative clothing is an organization layer, not species anatomy.
allowed_variation: skin presentation within validated Vorta bounds
notes: Specific clone lineage/identity must come from persistent entity state; visual similarity cannot establish continuity by itself.
